text: Coffee with Moira and Eva. Moira and her husband hit 25 years on Friday, they're doing a quiet dinner at the Italian place. Eva's gone vegan since the summer. Remind me to get Moira a card the day before.

Long catch-up with Santiago. He proposed to Rebecca last weekend, on the beach in Tenby apparently. Wedding probably next summer. She doesn't drink so the toast will be elderflower. Rebecca's dad cried when they FaceTimed him, Santiago said. They want an engagement drinks thing at ours, maybe the Saturday after. I should check with Zainab whether we can borrow her gazebo.
Rohan's new puppy is a beagle called Biscuit, came home Saturday. He's knackered. Zainab says he's not slept since.
Zainab's cat Pepper is having a tooth out next Tuesday. She's worried sick about the anaesthetic. Text her that evening to see how Pepper got on.
Antoine is coeliac, properly, not a fad. Ahmed only drinks oat flat whites. Worth knowing for Saturday.

Lunch with Shreya. Her sister Salma gets married in a fortnight in Leicester, three days of it. Shreya's doing the mehndi the day before and is nervous about her speech afterwards. Need to send her good luck that morning. Their mum keeps changing the menu because half the family is Jain and can't have onion or garlic.
Hassan and his wife have their 10th anniversary next Thursday. He wants to surprise her with a trip to Lisbon but hasn't booked anything. I said I'd send him the hotel link.
Emre's dog Ozzy turned one yesterday. They did a cake made of liver and sweet potato, no joke.
Pick up dog food and the flea stuff tomorrow before work.
Isabel called. The engagement party for her and Finn is off, her nan's back in hospital. They'll redo it once she's home. Must ring Isabel at the weekend to see how her nan's doing.

Magda hates coriander with a passion. Zara is lactose intolerant and won't touch cheese. Marisol eats anything. Dinner on Friday should be easy then. Zara said she'd bring dessert but she always forgets, so I'll grab a sorbet tomorrow just in case.

Jonah and Connor got engaged!! Connor asked him at the top of Snowdon on Sunday. Party is the Saturday after next at the Crown. Don't forget to get them something, Jonah dropped a hint about a decent cocktail shaker. Jonah's mum is already planning the hen and stag combined, which Connor finds terrifying.
Aoife's rabbit Clover died over the weekend. She's taking it badly, the kids too. Drop round with something on Wednesday.
Hannah says Leah, aka Lee, is off sugar for January. Keep in mind.
Varun's wedding anniversary is Monday. His wife Alana loves dark chocolate and red wine, nothing sweet.

Caught up with Duc after the school run. His cat Mochi has kidney problems, on a special diet now, vet again on Thursday. He's pretty down about it. Nikhil said he'd go with him. I should check in with Duc the day after the vet. Mochi was the cat Duc got when he moved here, so it's a big deal.
Siddharth's mum turns 70 this weekend and they're all going for afternoon tea. He's vegetarian, she's not, so they're arguing about venues.
Kaito and Alana renew their vows next Saturday, small thing in the garden. I'm doing the flowers that morning.
Joseph has a new job at the brewery, starts Monday. Free beer apparently. He's into sours lately, nothing too hoppy.
Jin's hamster escaped again. Found it in the boot of the car the next day. Unbelievable.
Quick one. Moira's daughter gets married on the 14th, the reception's at the golf club. Moira's a bit stressed about the seating plan.
Rebecca can't do nuts at all, carries an epipen. Make sure the restaurant knows before Friday.

Spoke to Santiago about the stag. It's in Porto, a month before the wedding. He wants me to sort a restaurant the night we arrive. Need to find somewhere that does good steak, Rohan's coming and he only eats meat basically. Book something by Friday.
Eva brought the new kitten round, a little tabby called Fig. Her partner Joseph wanted a dog but lost.
Hassan's sister Salma Thomas had her baby on Tuesday, a girl. Hassan is over the moon. Send something for the baby next week.
Zainab mentioned that she and Emre are thinking of eloping. Nothing booked. She'd rather do that than a big wedding with his family.
Ahmed's whippet Dusty needs an op on his leg next Friday. Ahmed's off work the next day to look after him. Message Ahmed afterwards, he'll be fretting.
Shreya's gone keto. Again. Eats eggs for every meal.

Dinner at Isabel's. Her brother Antoine is over from Lyon for a week, he's a pastry chef and very fussy about bread. Isabel's anniversary with Finn is Sunday, they're going to the coast for the day. Antoine's flying back the day after. Must take a bottle of something next time, Isabel prefers white.
Book the vet for the cat's jabs, maybe Thursday.

Marisol and Zara are hosting a barbecue next weekend to celebrate their engagement. Zara is pescatarian so bring fish. I'm making the potato salad. Marisol's mum is coming too and she's allergic to shellfish, so no prawns on the grill. Their dog Pablo will be roaming, keep the gate shut.
Magda's cockatiel is turning 20 on Saturday. She's throwing it a party, actually. Twenty years.
Saw Connor in town. He and Jonah have set the date, 12 June. Venue is a barn near Hay. Connor's nervous about the first dance and has booked lessons every Tuesday.
Remind me to ask Finn how the proposal went, he was doing it on Saturday at the lake.
Aoife's husband Siddharth had a coffee allergy scare, turns out it was the syrup. She's stopped buying the vanilla stuff.

Hannah and Leah are adopting a retired greyhound next month. Leah has been reading about it nonstop. Hannah is less keen but going along with it. Their landlord has said yes to a dog as long as it's under a certain size. They pick him up the Sunday after next.
Varun Singh, Nikhil and me for drinks. Varun only drinks IPA, Nikhil is teetotal since last year. Nikhil's anniversary with Jin is the week after next and he's planning a cooking class for them.
Duc's daughter's puppy, Bao, went missing on Sunday. Found that night at the park, thank god.
Siddharth asked if I'd be best man. Wedding is next August in Goa. I need to sort my passport before Christmas.
Kaito hates mushrooms, Alana loves them. Cooking for them Thursday so do two versions.

Long call with Joseph. His parents celebrate their ruby anniversary in three weeks, a party at the cricket club. He's doing a slideshow and wants old photos from me by Friday. His dad is diabetic so the cake needs to be sugar free, which Joseph is stressing over. Jin's baking it apparently. I should dig the photos out tonight.
Jin's cat Tofu has been off food for days. Vet says thyroid. Jin is anxious and hasn't been sleeping. Ring her tomorrow evening.
Rebecca's mum, Mrs Evans, is coming for the engagement dinner on Saturday. She's gluten free and doesn't drink. Rebecca wants it all perfect.
Emre told me his wedding is postponed to spring, the venue flooded. They're fine about it, mostly. His fiancée Zara still wants the same date in April.
Moira's labrador Barney is fourteen tomorrow. Old boy. She's doing him sausages for breakfast.
Need to buy a wedding present for Santiago and Rebecca before the list closes next Wednesday.
Zainab loves mint tea, never coffee. Hassan likes his espresso very strong. Good to know for the office.

Lunch with Eva and Hannah. Eva's planning to propose to Kaito in Rome next month, she's already got the ring and keeps checking her bag for it. Hannah thinks he'll cry. Eva's nervous he'll say no, which he won't. Don't forget to text Eva the day after she gets back.
Rohan says his grandad passed away on Monday. Funeral is Friday week. Rohan doesn't want a fuss but I'll send a card.
Antoine finally got his dog a passport so they can go to France together over Christmas.
Talked to Shreya after the wedding. Salma's speech went brilliantly, Shreya cried. They fly to Bali for the honeymoon on Thursday. Shreya's relieved it's all over.
Salma doesn't eat red meat, Shreya said, and the honeymoon hotel was told in advance.
Isabel mentioned Finn, or Finny as she calls him, has been getting really into natural wine. Anniversary present sorted then.
Cancelled dinner with Magda tonight, she's got a migraine. We'll rebook for next week.
Nothing major. Zara's moving her cat to a raw diet. Marisol thinks it's ridiculous.
Connor's brother Varun is getting married the same weekend as Jonah's sister. Chaos. They're splitting up for the day and meeting up afterwards.
Aoife and Siddharth celebrate 5 years next Tuesday. She mentioned wanting a new kettle, the old one leaks. I might chip in with Hannah.

Ahmed's parents are visiting next Sunday for their anniversary lunch and he's cooking biryani. His mum is diabetic and his dad hates spice, so he's toning it down. Ahmed is panicking a bit. Remember to ask him on Monday how it went.
Nikhil adopted a parrot. I have no further information.
Uncle Joseph's 30th wedding anniversary is Saturday. Auntie Marisol wants everyone there by 6. Bring the cake that morning, it's in my freezer.
